parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN activities act ON m.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2288' AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles;
